dn28:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
dn28:1.3: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn28:1.4: “evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante bhagavati, na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti”.
dn28:1.5: “uḷārā kho te ayaṃ sāriputta āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito:
dn28:1.7: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti’,
dn28:1.8: kiṃ te sāriputta ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā,
dn28:1.9: evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃdhammā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃpaññā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃvihārī te bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī?ti”
dn28:1.11: “kiṃ pana te sāriputta, ye te bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā,
dn28:1.12: evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto bhavissanti iti pi, evaṃdhammā …pe… evaṃpaññā, evaṃvihārī, evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto bhavissanti itipī?ti”.
dn28:1.14: “kiṃ pana te sāriputta, ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cetasā ceto paricca vidito
dn28:1.15: evaṃsīlo bhagavā iti pi evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño evaṃvihārī evaṃvimutto bhagavā itipī”?ti.
dn28:1.17: “ettha hi te sāriputta, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ natthi.
dn28:1.18: atha kiñcarahi te ayaṃ sāriputta uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito
dn28:1.19: “evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante bhagavati, na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyanti?”.
dn28:2.1: “na kho meṃ bhante, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ atthi.
dn28:2.2: api ca kho me bhante dhammanvayo vidito.
dn28:2.3: seyyathāpi bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷahuddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ,
dn28:2.4: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā,
dn28:2.5: so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā antamaso biḷāranissakkanamattampi,
dn28:2.7: ye keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā, sabbe te iminā’va dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā’ti.
dn28:2.8: evameva kho me bhante dhammanvayo vidito.
dn28:2.9: ye te bhante ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā, sattasambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
dn28:2.10: ye pi te bhavissanti. anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā satta sambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhissanti.
dn28:2.11: bhagavā pi bhante etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacitto satta sambojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho.
dn28:2.12: idāhaṃ bhante, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ dhammasavaṇāya.
dn28:2.13: tassa me bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi. uttaruttaraṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.
dn28:2.14: yathā yathā me bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ desesi uttaruttaraṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ, tathā tathāhaṃ tasmiṃ dhamme abhiññā idhekaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhammesu niṭṭhamagamaṃ, satthari pasīdiṃ,
dn28:2.15: ‘sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho’ti.
dn28:3.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti kusalesu dhammesu.
dn28:3.3: cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañcindriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
dn28:3.4: idha bhante bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchi katvā upasampajja viharati.
dn28:3.6: taṃ bhagavā asesamabhijānāti taṃ bhagavato asesamabhijānato uttariṃ abhiññeyyaṃ natthi, yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro assa yadidaṃ kusalesu dhammesu. āyatanapaṇṇatti
dn28:4.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti āyatanapaṇṇattīsu.
dn28:4.3: cakkhuva ca rūpāni ca sotañca saddā ca ghānañca gandhā ca jivhā ca rasā ca kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca mano ca dhammā ca.
dn28:4.5: taṃ bhagavā asesamabhijānāti. taṃ bhagavato asesamabhijānato uttariṃ abhiññeyyaṃ natthi, yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro assa yadidaṃ āyatanapaṇṇattīsu.
dn28:5.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti gabbhāvakkantīsu.
dn28:5.3: idha bhante, ekacco asampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, asampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati. ayaṃ paṭhamā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn28:5.4: puna caparaṃ bhante idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, asampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati. ayaṃ dutiyā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn28:5.5: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, sampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, asampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati. ayaṃ tatiyā gabbhāvakkanti.
dn28:5.6: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco sampajāno mātukucchiṃ okkamati, sampajāno mātukucchismiṃ ṭhāti, sampajāno mātukucchimhā nikkhamati. ayaṃ catutthi gabbhāvakkanti.
dn28:6.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti ādesanavidhāsu.
dn28:6.4: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, iti pi te cittanti’.
dn28:6.5: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
dn28:6.7: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati’.
dn28:6.8: evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti’.
dn28:6.9: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
dn28:6.11: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, nāpi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati. api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati
dn28:6.12: ‘evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti’.
dn28:6.13: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati tatheva taṃ hoti no aññathā.
dn28:6.15: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, nāpi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati, nāpi vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho vitakkavicārasamādhisamāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti –
dn28:6.16: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā, tathā imassa cittassa anantarā imaṃ nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkessatīti.
dn28:6.17: so bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti no aññathāti.
dn28:7.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti dassanasamāpattīsu.
dn28:7.3: idha bhante, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammāmanasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
dn28:7.4: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāra aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghānikā lasikā muttanti.
dn28:7.6: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathā samāhite citte imañceva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
dn28:7.7: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā …pe… lasikā muttanti,
dn28:7.8: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsa lohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati.
dn28:7.10: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte imañceva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
dn28:7.11: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā …pe… lasikā muttanti,
dn28:7.12: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsa lohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati,
dn28:7.13: purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke patiṭṭhitaṃ ca paraloke patiṭṭhitaṃ ca.
dn28:7.15: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe…
dn28:7.17: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati,
dn28:7.18: purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke appatiṭṭhitañca paraloke appatiṭṭhitañca.
dn28:8.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti puggalapaṇṇattīsu.
dn28:8.3: ubhatobhāgavimutto, paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī.
dn28:9.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti padhānesu.
dn28:9.2: sattime bhante sambojjhaṅgā: satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, viriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
dn28:10.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti paṭipadāsu.
dn28:10.2: catasso imā bhante paṭipadā: dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā,
dn28:10.6: tatra bhante yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ bhante paṭipadā ubhayeneva hīnā akkhāyati dukkhattā ca dandhattā ca.
dn28:10.7: tatra bhante yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ pana bhante paṭipadā dukkhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
dn28:10.8: tatra bhante yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ pana bhante paṭipadā dandhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
dn28:10.9: tatra bhante yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ pana bhante paṭipadā ubhayeneva paṇītā akkhāyati sukhattā ca khippattā ca.
dn28:11.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti bhassasamācāre.
dn28:11.2: idha bhante, ekacco na ceva musāvādūpasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na ca vebhūtiyaṃ na ca pesuṇiyaṃ na ca sārambhajaṃ jayāpekkho,
dn28:11.3: mantā mantā ca vācaṃ bhāsati nidhānavatiṃ kālena.
dn28:12.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti purisasīlasamācāre.
dn28:12.2: idha bhante, ekacco cassa saddho ca, na ca kuhako, na ca lapako, na ca nemittiko, na ca nippesiko, na ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijihiṃsanako indriyesu guttadvāro, bhojane mattaññū, samakārī, jāgariyānuyogamanuyutto, atandito, āraddhaviriyo, jhāyī, satimā, kalyāṇapaṭibhāno, gatimā, dhitimā, matimā, na ca kāmesu giddho, sato ca nipako ca.
dn28:13.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti anusāsanavidhāsu.
dn28:13.3: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā,
dn28:13.4: ‘ayaṃ puggalo yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno, tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno bhavissati avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti.
dn28:13.5: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā,
dn28:13.6: ayaṃ puggalo yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī bhavissati, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissatīti.
dn28:13.7: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā,
dn28:13.8: ayaṃ puggalo yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno, pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko bhavissati, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
dn28:13.9: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā,
dn28:13.10: ayaṃ puggalo yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchi katvā upasampajja viharissatīti.
dn28:14.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti parapuggalavimuttiñāṇe.
dn28:14.2: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yonisomanasikārā,
dn28:14.3: ayaṃ puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno bhavissati avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’ti.
dn28:14.4: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā,
dn28:14.5: ayaṃ puggalo tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī bhavissati sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissatī’ti.
dn28:14.6: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā,

dn28:14.8: jānāti bhante bhagavā paraṃ puggalaṃ paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā
dn28:14.9: ‘ayaṃ puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññā vimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchi katvā upasampajja viharissatī’ti.
dn28:15.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti sassatavādesu.
dn28:15.3: idha bhante, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya padhānamanvāya anuyogamanvāya appamādamanvāya sammā manasikāramanvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
dn28:15.4: seyyathīdaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo catasso pi jātiyo pañca pi jātiyo dasa pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattāḷīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekāni pi jātisatāni anekāni pi jātisahassāni anekāni pi jātisatasahassāni, amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃ sukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn28:15.6: atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi ‘saṃvaṭṭi pi loko vivaṭṭi pi’ ti.
dn28:15.7: anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi ‘saṃvaṭṭissati vā loko vivaṭṭissati vā ti.
dn28:15.8: sassato attā ca loko ca vañjho kūṭaṭṭho esikaṭṭhāyī ṭhito te’ca sattā sandhāvanti saṃsaranti cavanti upapajjanti, atthitveva sassatisamanti.
dn28:15.10: puna caparaṃ bhante, idhekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn28:15.11: seyyathīdaṃ ekampi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ dve pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni tīṇi pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni cattāri pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni pañca pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni dasa pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭāni amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṃgotto …pe… evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn28:15.13: atītampāhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi ‘saṃvaṭṭi vā loko vivaṭṭi vā loko.
dn28:15.14: anāgatañca khvāhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi saṃvaṭṭissati vā loko vivaṭṭissati vāti.

dn28:15.22: anāgatampāhaṃ addhānaṃ jānāmi ‘saṃvaṭṭissati pi loko vivaṭṭissati pī’ti.

dn28:16.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇe.
dn28:16.2: idha bhante, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati -
dn28:16.3: seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo catasso pi jātiyo pañca pi jātiyo dasa pi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattāḷīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo satampi jātiyo sahassampi jātiyo satasahassampi jātiyo aneke pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe
dn28:16.4: …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn28:16.5: santi bhante devā yesaṃ na sakkā gaṇanāya vā saṃkhānena vā āyuṃ saṅkhātuṃ,
dn28:16.6: api ca yasmiṃ yasmiṃ attabhāve abhinivutthapubbo hoti yadi vā rūpīsu yadi vā arūpīsu yadi vā saññīsu yadi vā asaññīsu yadi vā nevasaññīnāsaññīsu.
dn28:16.7: iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
dn28:17.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇe.
dn28:17.2: idha bhante, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne
dn28:17.3: hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti; ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
dn28:18.1: aparaṃ pana bhante etadānuttariyaṃ, yathā bhagavā dhammaṃ deseti iddhividhāsu.
dn28:18.3: atthi bhante, iddhi yā sāsavā saupadhikā no ariyā’ti vuccati.
dn28:18.4: atthi bhante iddhi yā anāsavā anupadhikā ariyā’ti.
dn28:18.5: katamā ca bhante, iddhi yā sāsavā saupadhikā no ariyā’ti vuccati?
dn28:18.6: idha bhante, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappamanvāya …pe… tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti:
dn28:18.7: eko pi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhā pi hutvā eko hoti, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse. paṭhaviyā pi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake. udake pi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāse pi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. ime pi candimasuriye evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati parimajjati. yāva brahmalokā pi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
dn28:18.8: ayaṃ bhante iddhi yā sāsavā saupadhikā no ariyā ti vuccati.
dn28:18.9: katamā pana bhante, iddhi yā anāsavā anupadhikā ariyā ti vuccati?
dn28:18.10: idha bhante, bhikkhu sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti, appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
dn28:18.11: sace ākaṅkhati appaṭikūle paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
dn28:18.12: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti appaṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
dn28:18.13: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca paṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti, paṭikūlasaññī tattha viharati.
dn28:18.14: sace ākaṅkhati paṭikūlañca appaṭikūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno’ti, upekkhako tattha viharati sato sampajāno.
dn28:18.15: ayaṃ pana bhante, iddhi anāsavā anupadhikā ariyā ti vuccati.
dn28:18.17: taṃ bhagavā asesamabhijānāti. taṃ bhagavato asesamabhijānato uttariṃ abhiññeyyaṃ natthi, yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro assa yadidaṃ iddhividhāsu. yantaṃ
dn28:19.1: bhante, saddhena kulaputtena pattabbaṃ āraddhaviriyena thāmavatā purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena purisadhorayhena, anuppattaṃ taṃ bhagavatā.
dn28:19.2: na ca bhante bhagavā kāmesu kāmasukhallikānuyogamanuyutto hīnaṃ gammaṃ pothujjanikaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ, na ca attakilamathānuyogamanuyutto dukkhaṃ anariyaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
dn28:19.3: catunnaṃ ca bhagavā jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. anuyogadānappakāro
dn28:19.6: ‘kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ aññe samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññatarā sambodhiyanti? evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante no’ti vadeyyaṃ.
dn28:19.7: ‘kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ aññe samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññatarā sambodhiyanti?’ evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante ‘no’ti vadeyyaṃ .
dn28:19.8: ‘kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta, atthetarahi añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo’bhiññataro sambodhiyanti?” evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante ‘no’ti vadeyyaṃ.
dn28:19.9: sace pana maṃ bhante evaṃ puccheyya
dn28:19.10: “kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ aññe samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhagavatā samasamā sambodhiyanti?’ evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante ‘evanti vadeyyaṃ.
dn28:19.11: ‘kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ aññe samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhagavatā samasamā sambodhiyanti?’ evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante ‘evanti’ vadeyyaṃ.
dn28:19.12: ‘kiṃ panāvuso sāriputta atthetarahi aññe samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhagavatā samasamā sambodhiyanti?’ evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante‘no’ti vadeyyaṃ.
dn28:19.13: sace pana maṃ bhante evaṃ puccheyya,
dn28:19.14: ‘kiṃ panāyasmā sāriputto ekaccaṃ abbhanujānāti ekaccaṃ nābbhanujānātī?’ti. evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
dn28:19.15: ‘sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
dn28:19.16: ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā mayā samasamā sambodhiyanti.
dn28:19.17: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
dn28:19.18: bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahantosammāsambuddhā mayā samasamā sambodhiyanti.
dn28:19.19: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
dn28:19.20: “aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve arahanto sammāsambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī”ti.
dn28:19.21: ekaccāhaṃ bhante evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva bhagavato homi, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāmi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaromi, na ca koci sahadhammiko. vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī?ti”
dn28:19.22: “tagghatvaṃ sāriputta evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me hoti na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhasi, dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākarosi, na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī”ti. acchariyabbhutāni
dn28:20.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn28:20.2: “acchariyaṃ bhante abbhutaṃ bhante tathāgatassa appicchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā.
dn28:20.3: yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo, atha ca pana nevattānaṃ pātukarissati.
dn28:20.4: ekamekaṃ cepi ito bhante dhammaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā attani samanupasseyyuṃ, te tāvatakeneva paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ.
dn28:20.5: acchariyaṃ bhante abbhutaṃ bhante tathāgatassa appicchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā.
dn28:20.6: yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo. atha ca pana nevattānaṃ pātukarissatī”ti.
dn28:20.7: “passa kho tvaṃ udāyi: tathāgatassa appicchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā.
dn28:20.8: yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo, atha ca pana nevattānaṃ pātukarissati.
dn28:20.9: ekamekaṃ cepi ito udāyi dhammaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā attani samanupasseyyuṃ, te tāvatakeneva paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ.
dn28:20.10: passa kho tvaṃ udāyi: tathāgatassa appicchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā.
dn28:20.11: yatra hi nāma tathāgato evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo, atha ca pana nevattānaṃ pātukarissatī”ti.
dn28:21.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
dn28:21.2: “tasmātiha tvaṃ sāriputta imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ abhikkhaṇaṃ bhāseyyāsi bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
dn28:21.3: yesampi hi sāriputta moghapurisānaṃ bhavissati tathāgate kaṅkhā vā vimati vā tesamimaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā yā tathāgate kaṅkhā vā vimati vā sā pahīyissatī”ti.
dn28:21.4: iti hidaṃ āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato sammukhā sampasādaṃ pavedesi.
